hook_text: I was a zombie all week

song.title: Back From The Dead
song.style: English, spooky surf rockabilly with twangy reverb guitar, slapped upright bass, theremin swoops and handclaps, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, playful, 124 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Seven days I shuffled slow
Thumb on glass and face aglow
Didn't need a zombie mask
Scrolling was my only task

[Chorus]
Wake up, wake up, it's Halloween
Phone's asleep in its brick of green
Wake up, wake up, the night is new
Back from the dead and I'm dancing with you

[Verse]
Carved a grin on a pumpkin head
Bobbed for apples, soaking wet
Knocked on doors down leafy streets
Trading jokes for candy sweets

[Chorus]
Wake up, wake up, it's Halloween
Realest night I've ever seen
Wake up, wake up, the moon is high
Back from the dead and I feel alive

shots.prompt: FPV drone shot racing low down a dark clay street straight at {moss} shuffling like a zombie with stiff arms out, a sickly green glow on his face, the camera flying right up to his glasses. Green glow, deep shadows.
Crash zoom into {moss}'s glazed eyes behind his round black glasses, green light flickering across the lenses. Cold green glow.
Extreme close-up of a chunky plasticine thumb flicking up and up on a phone that glows plain white, the camera spinning fast around the thumb. Cold white glow in the dark.
{moss} walks face-first into a lamppost and bounces backwards, wobbling. Low angle, the camera whips sideways with the impact. Dim street light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, his mouth opening wide under his bushy mustache, rubber monster masks hanging in a shop window behind him. The camera pushes in fast. Shop window glow.
A row of rubber monster masks in a shop window all turn their heads at once, the camera whip-panning across them. Purple and green shop light.
Overhead shot spinning fast above {moss} slumped on a saggy sofa staring at his phone while orange autumn leaves pour in through the window and bury him. Gloomy grey room, orange leaves.
Dolly zoom on {moss}'s face as he finally looks up from his phone, the room stretching away behind him. One warm streak of light.
Close-up: {moss} leaps up in his kitchen and sings to the camera, mouth wide open under his mustache, a glowing jack-o-lantern beside him. The camera snaps in close. Warm flickering candle light.
A carved jack-o-lantern on a kitchen counter bursts alight, its grin blazing. Crash zoom into its glowing mouth. Orange firelight.

A hand slides a black smartphone face-first into a small rounded moss-green brick stuck to a white fridge door, the phone settling upright. The brick has a round pale yellow disc on its front. Warm flickering orange candle light drifts across the fridge. Close-up, the camera quickly pulls back as the hand flicks away.
{moss} slams the fridge door shut with a hip bump and spins away dancing. The camera whips around with him. Warm candle light.

{moss} kicks open his round front door and a tornado of orange leaves blasts toward the camera. The camera rushes out through the doorway past him into the moonlit street. Warm porch light, deep blue night.
FPV drone shot swooping off a porch and up over the rooftops of a tiny clay town glowing with jack-o-lanterns. Warm orange glow under a deep blue sky.

Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera, mouth moving with the words under his mustache, dancing with a little kid in a white bedsheet ghost costume. The camera orbits fast around them. warm orange lantern light.
A little kid in a white bedsheet ghost costume spins round and round, the camera spinning with them, string lights streaking past. warm orange lantern light.
{moss} scoops the gooey insides out of a fat orange pumpkin and flings a handful straight at the camera. Splat. warm orange lantern light.
Crash zoom into a freshly carved pumpkin as a candle flares inside and its toothy grin lights up. Orange firelight in the dark.
{moss} pops up out of a tub of floating red apples with water exploding upward, an apple in his teeth, glasses crooked. Low angle, the camera tilts up fast. Warm porch light, flying water.
Extreme close-up of water drops flying off round black glasses, the camera whipping past. Sparkling warm light.
FPV shot racing behind {moss} as he runs up the steps of a crooked little house and knocks on a round green door. warm orange lantern light, autumn leaves flying.
A round green door flies open and a cheerful old woman in a pointy witch hat thrusts a huge bowl of candy at the camera. Crash zoom. Warm doorway light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera on a doorstep beside a giggling little girl in a puffy pumpkin costume, swapping candies. The camera circles them quickly. Cosy orange porch light.
Wrapped candies tumble through the air toward the camera as it spins. Bright colourful candy, warm light.
Close-up: {moss} sings to the camera at a street party, mouth wide open under his mustache, string lights and stacked pumpkins behind him. The camera pushes in fast. Warm string-light glow.
Three neighbours dressed as a witch, a skeleton and a bedsheet ghost jump into the air together, the camera whipping up with them. warm orange lantern light.
{moss} leads a conga line of costumed neighbours through piles of orange leaves, the camera racing alongside at ground level as leaves blast past the lens. warm orange lantern light.
A clay skeleton drops into the splits on the street and throws his arms up. Crash zoom. warm orange lantern light.
The camera rockets straight up from a glowing street past a flock of little black paper bats toward a huge full moon. Silver moon, warm orange street below.
A flock of little black paper bats swarms straight at the camera and bursts apart around it. Silver moonlight.

Close-up: {moss} throws his arms wide and sings to the camera under a huge full moon, mouth wide under his mustache, orange leaves swirling. The camera orbits fast and rises. Warm lantern light on his face, deep blue sky.
{moss} falls backwards into a huge pile of orange leaves laughing as the leaves explode upward. The camera cranes up and away. Warm lantern light, deep blue night.

caption: moss was a phone zombie all week. one night with his phone asleep in the Hibernator and he came back to life. happy halloween
